attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter thakre-care-home
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 thakre-care-home dhunche-school
load car1 child 2
drive car1 dhunche-school benighat-care-home
drive car1 benighat-care-home tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
unload car1 child 2
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter benighat-care-home
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 benighat-care-home tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
</plan>
COST: 136

Notes:
- Dhunche school is not a designated evacuation point, so the children are carried to Tarkeshwar shelter.
- The first trip carries four people at once (the Thakre couple and the two pupils), so the Benighat pensioners need a second trip.
- No one is deferred. Every alternative I checked cost more, including deferring the children (120 in penalties) or the Thakre couple (100).
